svg.title: Tech stack by category
svg.desc: Categorised technologies with evidence markers. desktop / cli: PySide6 / Qt, Typer, Tkinter, PyQt5, Flask + Socket.IO, Streamlit. imaging / ml: OpenCV, NumPy, Pillow, PyTorch, timm, transformers, scikit-learn, NLTK, CuPy, Numba. systems: WPD / COM, PTP / MTP, libusb, ExifTool, Scapy, psutil. data: SQLite, Oracle Database. testing / qa: pytest, pytest-qt, hypothesis, ruff, mypy, regression testing, mobile / web QA, Jira. build / release: GitHub Actions, uv, hatchling, PyInstaller, Inno Setup. mobile: Flutter, Dart. security: packet classification, network diagnostics, Linux / WSL2.
